description: Passive and active secret-detection extension for Burp Suite. Detects exposed API keys, credentials, PII, JWTs, and connection strings in HTTP and WebSocket traffic using 150+ anchored vendor token rules, 270+ context-gated rules, entropy-based heuristics, and a Bulk Scan tab with CSV, HTML, JSON and SARIF report export.
author: Hemanth Gorijala
